 Ms. Lovitt.

 MS. LOVITT: Thank you, Mr. Chief
Justice, and may it please the Court:
 In Bissonnette and Saxon, this Court
held that a Section 1 transportation worker
must be actively engaged in transportation of
 goods across borders.  The class of workers
must be directly and actively performing
 cross-border transportation work.
 Brock picks up goods from a warehouse
 in Colorado and delivers them to retail outlets
 in Colorado.  When he takes the goods, they've
crossed their last border and they have been
unloaded from the interstate vehicle carrying
 them. Mr. Brock performs no work in
 cross-border transportation and is not exempt
 under Section 1.
